violations.text: The hand-washing sink in the kitchen was blocked by containers. A hand-washing sink shall be accessible at all times for employee use. Corrected On-Site. New Violation. Correct By: 08/11/2026
The facility is lacking test strips to measure the concentration of the quat sanitizing solution for the 3 bay sink. Establishment is to obtain test strips New Violation. Correct By: 08/18/2026
The door to the back toilet room is not self-closing. Toilet rooms that open to food prep areas must be self closing. New Violation. Correct By: 06/14/2025

The dumpster outside is located on grass/gravel. The outdoor storage surface for refuse, recyclables, and returnables must be constructed of nonabsorbent material such as concrete or asphalt and must be smooth, durable, and sloped to drain. New Violation. Correct By: 05/21/2025
